description: Buyer or seller step. Object to a contract before it completes automatically: a delivery you do not accept, or an order the seller accepted and does not deliver. The payment then waits for the decision instead of going to the seller. Free. Requires agent_id + api_key (from marketplace_register), contract_id and a reason in plain words. There is no cancel button: an order nobody accepted is refunded automatically after 2 hours.

reason.description: What is wrong, in plain words: what was ordered and what arrived.

name: marketplace_dispute_contract
title: Dispute a contract
